## Launch readiness

**Recommendation:** proceed with an admin-only SSO pilot for up to three design partners, confirming each account's consent, export expectations, and stop/recovery plan. Meridian accepts this limited trial; broader operations access should wait.

**Limits:** October 16 is a target. Broader rollout needs committed export scope, customer review of the example and fields, broader-access acceptance, and actual recovery evidence. These conclusions use only fictional Slack/email fixtures; no live accounts were accessed. Choose the scope below.

| Evidence | Supported scope or limit |
| --- | --- |
| [Slack: Engineering](https://example.com/northstar/slack/launch-readiness): SSO passed staging; three partners can start. | Admin-only pilot, with account-specific consent. |
| [Email: Meridian](https://example.com/northstar/email/meridian-pilot): admin trial may proceed during export review. | Broader access needs an export example and confirmed fields. |
| [Slack: Engineering](https://example.com/northstar/slack/launch-readiness): export owner and date are uncommitted. | Confirm ownership and scope before offering dates. |
| [Slack: Platform](https://example.com/northstar/slack/launch-readiness): rollback rehearsal booked for October 12. | Booking is not tested recovery; assess the result. |

Launch dependencies: SSO and account consent support the admin-only pilot; export scope/example and recovery evidence support broader rollout readiness. Both inform the human scope choice.

Choose one launch direction: bounded admin-only pilot; hold invitations; or pursue broader rollout after readiness conditions are verified. Optional: record account constraints or required evidence.
